ConnectionStrings.//: The database of this installation - set it here (in Visual Studio before publishing, or in this file on the server after publishing; it is re-read when saved, no restart). Example: Server=SQLSERVER;Database=HRMS_Kuwait;User Id=hrms_app;Password=YourPassword;   Windows sign-in: Server=SQLSERVER;Database=HRMS_Kuwait;Integrated Security=True;

Database.//TrustServerCertificate: true = accept the SQL Server's own (self-signed) certificate - the usual case. false only with a certificate from a trusted authority.

Authentication.//: Sign-in policy. Lockout is enforced in Security.usp_Auth_Manage.
Authentication.//SimplePassword: true = also store passwords as plain text in Security.Users.[Password] (db/27), sign in against it, and drop the password strength rules. Readable by anyone with database access - keep false in production.

DocumentStorage.//: Employee document uploads. Relative paths resolve against the app folder. Keep this OUTSIDE wwwroot - files are served only through /employees/documents/... for signed-in users.

Email.//: Payslip emails. Off until Enabled is true and Host / FromAddress are set - queued emails wait until then. The email links to My Payslips and carries no salary figures. Set the SMTP password with user secrets or the environment (Payslips__Email__Password), never here.
